heroTitle: Rediscover what really matters; to thrive during the AI singularity.
heroIntro: We're a developing initiative that explores how a more enriching life can grow and flourish, even in a changing world seemingly made smaller by AI's displacement of work and creation.
developmentNotice: Project Meaning is in early development. Our activities and programs are being explored, not yet offered.
whyTitle: Embrace human uniqueness in the face of AI's displacement of cognitive and kinetic work.
whyLead: AI brings opportunity to rediscover our unique human value.
whyBody: Project Meaning explores how to live the answers to these questions -- not merely discuss them -- in practical, human and everyday ways.
closingBody: Project Meaning is a developing initiative. We’re exploring what it could become and how people might participate in shaping its future.
